title: Tidy one side before you move anything

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: A load standing on one pan. It settles inward-out.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.

worldFraming.text: Gather the near pan before you lift anything off it. Nobody carries two stacks at once.

ask.text: Author a claim on this site that closes at 5.

hints.text: A load standing on one pan. It settles inward-out.
The far pan is the site. You are authoring the near one.
Whatever you write, seating 5 has to leave the Sill level.
